name: Wereleopard Aristocrat 6
body:
Wereleopard Aristocrat 6 (Human Form)

CR 5

XP 1,600
Male human afflicted wereleopard aristocrat 6
CE Medium humanoid (shapechanger)
Init +1; Senses low-light vision, scent; Perception +13

DEFENSE

AC 16, touch 11, flat-footed 15 (+5 armor, +1 Dex)
hp 33 (6d8+6)
Fort +2, Ref +5, Will +6
DR n/a

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee +1 vicious punching dagger +8 (1d4+2d6+4/×3)

STATISTICS

Str 16, Dex 12, Con 11, Int 8, Wis 12, Cha 7
Base Atk +4; CMB +6; CMD 17
Feats Alertness, Lightning Reflexes, Improved Natural Attack (bite), Toughness
Skills Acrobatics +7, Bluff +7, Perception +13, Stealth +7
Languages Common, +1 additional
SQ change shape (human, hybrid, and leopard; polymorph)
Combat Gear potion of cure light wounds (2); Other Gear +1 chain shirt, En-Nebi (see sidebar), 450 gp

Wereleopard Aristocrat 6 (Hybrid Form)

XP 1,600
Male human afflicted wereleopard aristocrat 6
CE Medium humanoid (shapechanger)
Init +4; Senses low-light vision, scent; Perception +13

DEFENSE

AC 22, touch 14, flat-footed 18 (+5 armor, +4 Dex, +3 natural)
hp 45 (6d8+18)
Fort +4, Ref +8, Will +6
DR 5/silver

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee +1 vicious punching dagger +9 (1d4+2d6+5/×3), bite +3 (2d6+2) or bite +8 (2d6+4), 2 claws +8 (1d3+4)
Special Attacks pounce, rake (2 claws +6, 1d3+4)

STATISTICS

Str 18, Dex 19, Con 15, Int 8, Wis 13, Cha 7
Base Atk +4; CMB +8; CMD 22
Feats Alertness, Lightning Reflexes, Improved Natural Attack (bite), Toughness
Skills Acrobatics +10, Bluff +7, Perception +13, Stealth +10 (+14 in undergrowth)
Languages Common, +1 additional
SQ change shape (human, hybrid, and leopard; polymorph), lycanthrophic empathy (leopards)
Combat Gear potion of cure light wounds (2); Other Gear +1 chain shirt, En-Nebi (see sidebar), 450 gp
